description: Improve the analytics package's ability to detect when it's running in a browser extension background script context. This should ensure analytics events are properly categorized and processed based on the execution environment, particularly for WebExtensions where background scripts have different capabilities and lifecycle than content scripts or regular web pages.
functional_requirements: Update the detection logic to correctly identify browser extension background scripts according to WebExtensions API specifications
Ensure the detection works across different browsers that support the WebExtensions standard (Chrome, Firefox, Edge)
Maintain backward compatibility with existing analytics event collection and processing
Add appropriate type definitions or constants to distinguish background script context from other execution environments
Update any environment-specific analytics behavior that depends on the background script detection
